messages:
sam: Quick help please. Returning from Amsterdam after a 1-day customer visit. Eurostar was cancelled due to industrial action, I couldn't get an earlier train and had to book an unexpected hotel for the night and a later train next morning. Company booked initial outbound/return but the delayed return was on my personal card. Can I expense the extra hotel + meals + the higher fare? cc @travel-ops

elaine: Sorry that happened :grimacing: Short answer: we reimburse reasonable incremental costs caused by carrier cancellations/strikes when they prevent you from completing business travel the same day. You'll need receipts + proof of disruption (train cancellation notice or screenshot).

sam: What counts as "reasonable"? My hotel was 120 for the night, dinner 28, new ticket difference 45. Also the card charge shows a small foreign processing fee.

travel-ops: Reimbursement rules: 1) Hotel: reimbursable if delay was outside your control and required. 2) Meals: reimbursed as incidentals subject to perdiem caps for the city. 3) Ticket fare difference: reimbursable if you bought a later or faster option to get home. 4) CC foreign transaction fees: reimbursable if charged on personal card for an eligible business expense.

sam: Do I need to book manager approval first? I already paid and submitted nothing yet.

anna: Manager note: retro approvals are ok for these cases. Please add a short manager approval comment in Expensify or ask me to approve once you submit. I approve in principle.

finance-bot: Policy excerpt: "Travel disruptions due to carrier cancellations/strikes that are documented are eligible for reimbursement of incremental lodging, transport, and meal costs. Attach disruption evidence. Lost receipt attestation allowed up to 75 per item. Perdiem caps apply. Foreign currency amounts should be converted with the bank card exchange rate; show card statement line when possible."

elaine: Practical upload steps: create one expense for the original trip (no change), one incident expense labeled `delay - 2026-03-14` with items: hotel 120 (attach folio), dinner 28 (receipt), ticket diff 45 (attach new ticket), FX fee 3 (card statement screenshot). In your expense note include train cancellation screenshot and short timeline: "Eurostar cancelled 09:15, rebooked 22:00, overnight required". Tag project `ACCT-EMEA` and add "manager:anna" in the notes.

sam: If I only have a PDF boarding confirmation for the new ticket (no itemized invoice), is that OK?

travel-ops: Yes PDF ticket/confirmation is fine as long as it shows fare and card charged. If vendor only shows a total charge, add a short attestation explaining the breakdown.

sam: Thanks. Last Q: my original reserved return was refundable but I couldn't process the refund until now; can I claim the full extra cost now and we'll net the refund later?

finance-bot: If you receive a refund later, we will offset that against reimbursement. If the refund posts to the same card, upload the refund evidence and we'll adjust in payroll/expense reconciliation. Note this may result in a small repayment if reimbursement already paid out.

sam: Great, uploading now. Appreciate the quick help :pray:
